stories.story_fr: Pendant la tempete hivernale Fern, le taux de disponibilite de production d'EQT a ete environ deux fois meilleur que celui de ses pairs d'Appalachia, permettant de capter des prix eleves tout en alimentant des millions de foyers.
stories.story_en: During Winter Storm Fern, EQT's production uptime was about twice as good as Appalachia peers, capturing strong in-basin pricing while supplying millions of homes.
stories.quote: Production uptime during Winter Storm Fern was ~2x better than Appalachia peers, providing critical energy to consumers while maximizing exposure to strong in-basin pricing.

stories.story_fr: La croissance acceleree de la demande d'electricite aux Etats-Unis, en particulier en Appalachia, cree des opportunites locales qu'EQT peut servir via ses contrats GNL long terme ou la demande domestique.
stories.story_en: Accelerating US power demand growth, particularly in Appalachia, creates in-backyard opportunities EQT can serve through long-term LNG contracts or domestic demand.
stories.quote: accelerating power demand growth in the United States - particularly in Appalachia - is creating incremental opportunities in our backyard.

stories.story_fr: EQT a battu plusieurs records operationnels au T4 2025 (rythme de completion le plus rapide, footage lateral record), avec un cout moyen de puits par pied en baisse de 13% sur un an.
stories.story_en: EQT broke multiple operational records in Q4 2025, including fastest completions pace and most lateral footage, with 2025 average well cost per foot down 13% year-over-year.
stories.quote: 2025 average well cost per foot was 13% lower year-over-year and 6% below internal expectations.

stories.story_fr: Le T1 2026 a genere un flux de tresorerie disponible trimestriel record attribuable a EQT de 1,832 milliard de dollars, soutenu par une plateforme integree a faible cout de revient.
stories.story_en: Q1 2026 generated record quarterly free cash flow attributable to EQT of $1,832 million, supported by a low-breakeven integrated platform.
stories.quote: generated record quarterly free cash flow attributable to EQT of $1,832 million.

stories.story_fr: EQT a signe des accords d'enlevement GNL pour 4,5 millions de tonnes par an au total avec Sempra, NextDecade et Commonwealth LNG a partir de 2030-2031, concretisant sa strategie GNL.
stories.story_en: EQT signed LNG offtake agreements for 4.5 million tonnes per annum in aggregate with Sempra, NextDecade and Commonwealth LNG beginning in 2030-2031.
stories.quote: Signed LNG offtake agreements for 4.5 million tonnes per annum in aggregate with Sempra, NextDecade and Commonwealth LNG beginning in 2030-2031.
